name: tr_jimmy
caption:
IF JIMMY WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🐜 Trapinch, the overlooked one: no recruiters, then pick #30, last in round 1
🐉 Flygon, the evolution: 2015 Most Improved Player
🦹 Sneasel, the thief: led the NBA in steals in 2021
🌋 Heatran, Playoff Jimmy: 56 points in one playoff game, a Heat record
⚡ Zeraora, big moments: 38 in his first play-in for us
🔥 Moltres, the ace: 20.0 points a night in 38 games before the ACL

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Butler: not recruited out of high school, went to Tyler Junior College; 2011 draft 30th overall by Chicago, the last pick of the first round (pick 31 started round 2); 2015 NBA Most Improved Player; NBA steals leader in 2021; career-high 56 points in game 4 vs Milwaukee in 2023, Miami Heat franchise playoff record; April 15 (2025) play-in debut with the Warriors: 38 points in a 121-116 win over Memphis; torn right ACL January 19, 2026; through 38 games averaged 20.0 points
2011 NBA draft: Jimmy Butler round 1 pick 30 (30th) by Chicago; round 2 pick 31 Bojan Bogdanovic
